118361.overview:
Robot Unicorn Attack is an online "endless running" video game featured on the Adult Swim and Flashline Games website. The game was produced by Spiritonin Media Games and was released in February 4, 2010. The game's soundtrack is the 1994 song "Always," by the British band Erasure, in its "2009 mix" version.

With one million plays within the first week of its release, Robot Unicorn Attack is one of the most popular and most played games featured on Adult Swim. As a result of its popularity, Adult Swim has made official merchandise for the game, and has released it on the App Store and Google Play. Adult Swim released three followups to Robot Unicorn Attack, subtitled Heavy Metal, Christmas Edition, and Evolution respectively.

151543.overview:
Hit the park for some extreme BMX action! Ride, jump, tailwhip, backflip and superman to score the most points during the time limit.

You have 90 seconds to earn as many points as possible. You can do this by doing backflips, 360s, tailwhips and nothing. The BMX park is fairly big, allowing you to do tricks in many different areas. If you chain tricks together you will earn more points than you would usually, but you must be sure to land them or else your points will go to waste! It is best if you look at the controls before trying to set a high score!

151865.overview:
Catch me if you can! Do you have what it takes to tackle the Free Run obstacle course?
In this game, you must be interested in free run. There are a lot of barriers you can meet. What you should do will be point out. Do this. React to key prompts and don’t stop running! You need to Faster your time and try to get the higher score. Free run means you must keep running. So, if you stop or do the wrong actions, unfortunately you’d better replay this game. When this game point out what you should do next, you must do it right now, not do it in front of the barriers. You can practice your competence through this game. Free run must be a game you shouldn’t miss.

198736.overview:
Beloved games Wolfenstein 3D, created by Id Software & published by Apogee Software in 1992, and Super Monkey Ball, created by Amusement Vision & published by Sega in 2001, have crossed paths in this totally free arcade fangame!

Fight your way through eight procedurally generated floors to escape the fortress! Collect bananas and treasure to maximize your score and defeat guards for time bonuses! Just get to the end before the timer runs out! Lose all three of your lives and it's game over for you.

Are you tough enough to take on this challenge and break free from the grips of your captors?

219223.overview: Riddle School is a point-and-click adventure puzzle game developed by Newgrounds user JonBro (now known as Jonochrome). The first in a long running series, players play as Phil Eggtree and attempt to escape from school.

419400.overview:
Reset Generation is a turn-based strategy game. The game is based around a "capture the flag" concept, but instead of flags, players need to be capture the opponents princess and bring her back to their castle.

Players can choose their characters, each character being a parody of other franchises' characters, each with their own special ability. The Plumber's special ability is Ladies Man, through which he can get any item on the map. The Hedgehog can travel great distances with the special Hog Ride ability. The Level 50 Elf can lay combo tiles with her Combo Staff +1. The Babe Gunner can leap diagonally, shooting those beneath her. The Agressor, with his 4-bit Weapon attack can launch a four way laser shot. The Cyborg can use his rocket jump to jump great distances, destroying block and scorching those underneath him. Dr. Lovebomber can blast his foes and change blocks to his color with his bombs. The Monster Trainer can summon an Evil Dark Wizard to burn her enemies and to blast blocks. The Ninja can switch places with other characters. Lastly, The Sci-Fi Knight can use her Mind Trick to temporarily control other characters.

Each turn is split up into three stages: in the first stage, players get to drop tetris blocks unto the game's grid based floor. The blocks are dropped in the same time for every player, so if to blocks overlap, then they will cancel each other out. These blocks give the player additional movement and make their character stronger if they are standing on them. If five or more blocks are in a line, a combo is achieved making the blocks even more powerful and also invulnerable against normal cannon fire. In the second stage, the characters can be moved and their special powers can be used. In the third stage the castle can fire it's cannons to destroy simple blocks.

The game's original soundtrack is by the chip music band 8 Bit Weapon. Their use of classic gaming consoles and vintage 8 bit computers as musical instruments compliments the retro theme of the game as a whole.

439165.overview: The player has to kill the popups before they take control of the screen.

451314.overview: RAGE III is an action game developed by Seth Wooten. It is the third entry of the RAGE series. In this game, you harness your rage to defeat all the enemies in front of you.

451315.overview: The third game of the Raze series is set 10 years after the second game. This time extensive training is used to quickly recruit soldiers into the ranks. Levels contain a diverse number of alien, robotic and zombie enemies. In the campaign, there are also some cutscenes between levels. Depending on the player's performance will determine how many credits earned after finishing a level. With those credits weapons and upgrades can be purchased.

451317.overview:
Ragdoll Cannon is the shareware version of a popular Flash physics-based browser game. Each level is a screen with simple graphics, where the objective is to shoot humanoid stick figures from a cannon towards the switch, usually a box with the words "HERE". Many obstacles are in the way, like ropes, bricks and boulders that react with each doll impact in the simulated physics model. Swirling portals transport the flying figures to another point in the screen. There's no limit of time or to the number of shots available.

The full version has 150 levels (20 in the shareware version) and three additional music tracks.

451319.overview:
Radical Fishing is a fast-paced fishing game that consists of two parts. First the player lowers the hook as low as possible (up to 500 meter below sea level) and then tries to pull in as much fish as possible Katarmari-style when the line is reeled in. During that phase the hook can still be moved left to right to catch the fish. Once the surface is reached, all fish are launched into the air and need to be shot down to earn cash. Cash is spent at a shop to acquire all sorts of upgrades such as a lamp to see in the dark, a better line to fish deeper, extra boot, or stronger guns to take down the fish more quickly.

Each layer in the sea introduces new types of fish. A newly-discovered type is stored in the fishopedia. It takes however a number of upgrades to reach the deeper parts of the ocean; not everything is available right away. A few more mechanics add to the gameplay. While lowering the hook, all fish need to be avoided. As soon as a fish touches it, the line is reeled in immediately. Later parts of the game introduce upgrades that provide second chances or the ability to start at a certain depth right away. Certain fish are also aware of the hook and will attempt to chase it down. While lowering the hook, the player has access to a boost meter to gain depth more quickly. This is not without risk as it increases the chance of bumping into a fish. Finally, not all fish launched into the air can be converted into cash. If they drop back into the sea without being shot, the money is lost. The same gameplay is repeated until everything in the game is unlocked.

451320.overview: Raiden X is a flash tribute to the classic shoot-em-up "Raiden". In this game, you pilot an aircraft among a swarm of enemies to blast apart anything in your way with a myriad of high-tech weapons. The game features 8 stages each with a boss at the end. Raiden X is one of the most complex games in the arcade, due to the sheer amount of options and features contained within it.

451321.overview: Ray is a series of choose-your-own-adventure games developed by Philljc. It has 2 games in the series.

451322.overview:
This game puts the player behind the welding mask of a tough guy busy souping up his ride in his garage when he hears the emergency broadcast signal interrupt his tunes on the radio and learns that the zombie apocalypse is at hand. The officials issue a statement ordering martial law, instructing citizens to remain indoors behind locked doors at risk of being shot on sight, but our hero knows that it's better to live fast and die young to ensure that you leave a good-looking corpse. Getting the Hell out of Dodge, he hops into his sweet wheels and plots the straightest course between home and the rural wilderness where he can hole up and wait the coming troubles out like a survivalist instead of a sitting duck.

The most direct route between these two points would typically be a straight line, and the highway from hell is indeed a straightway with no exits... but it is cluttered with lurching zombies, panicking civilians, and the abandoned cars and burned-out wrecks they formerly drove, along with a wide array of detritus and half-deployed traffic redirection equipment. Provided the player maintains enough speed, ramming the zombies is a straightforward enough affair (regular use of the wipers to sluice the gore off the windshield helps with visibility, as does crashing into water-filled traffic barriers) but points are lost for mulching folks who aren't yet undead and running over a zombie too slowly can result in them taking up an ominous and view-obstructing position on the car's hood. Complicating things, the military is taking their quarantine order very seriously, and deploy increasing forces against this wild card who keeps blasting through their zombie containment barriers in his car, starting with grunts shooting at the car and escalating to tire spike belts, helicopters and carpet bombing.

The game has four multi-stage scenarios, each of which must be completed before unlocking the next. Adding to the addiction factor, players' accomplishments in one escape attempt can be used to upgrade the car's toughness for future attempts.

451323.overview:
Robot Dinosaurs That Shoot Beams When They Roar is a short shoot-em-up in which two robot dinosaurs land on Earth to protect all human beings from alien invaders. Players can choose between Tyrannosaurus X or Dinomite, in order to defeat the invading hordes, who are, as the title implies, robot dinosaurs that shoot beams when they roar!

The chosen robot dinosaur flies horizontally and can be controlled with the mouse. Enemies can be killed with the laser beam the dinosaurs shoot from their mouths, but these deplete and weaken as they are used, so the player will have to wait for them to recharge.

There's only one level, for which the player has three lives. Enemies come in few varieties: swarming ones, a few ones that split when hit, turrets, spawning voids, and a special boss at the end of the level.

451325.overview:
Rogue Soul is an endless running platformer game developed by SoulGame Studio.  It revolves around a rogue who wants to become the most famous criminal in the city.

Rogue Soul has you take control of the titular character, Rogue Soul, as he runs through the city looking to raise the bounty on his head to 5,000 Soulons in order to become more famous than Borin Hood, the current most famous criminal in the city.  Throughout the game, he runs automatically and defeats enemies on contact unless they hit him with one of their attacks.  The objective is to rack up as many Soulons on Rogue Soul's bounty by collecting treasure, defeating enemies, and getting as far as you can without getting killed by an enemy or hazard - Rogue Soul slowly earns Soulons on his bounty while running in addition to earning some whenever he defeats enemies or collects treasure.  Every so often, Rogue Soul enters a new zone, which acts as a checkpoint.  If Rogue Soul is defeated, you can use a continue to respawn at the beginning of the current zone you were in.  You get two continues per game; after being defeated a third time, you start over.

451326.overview:
The day after Reiko marries into the patrician Tsubakikoji family her beloved husband dies, leaving her with nothing but a rose and the scorn of his family. Despite her low origins Reiko is determined, as wife of Shunsuke, eldest son of the Tsubakikoji house, to claim her title as mistress. But the mocking aristocrats that make up the female members of the main family branch deny her rightful position. Clutching the rose given her by Shunsuke on their wedding night she prepares to prove her case, by force if necessary, and put the wicked blue-bloods in their place.

Rose & Camellia is set in a seemingly Japanese house with a mix of Victorian themes. All clothing is Victorian, all names are characteristic of Japan. The goal of the game is to gain the respect of the other women in the Tsubakikoji by slapping them silly, but one need watch out as they can have brutal back hands.

Once the womanly battle begins a time bar will appear across the top of the screen and a small attack box in the right corner behind Reiko. By dragging your cursor in an arc from this box to your opponent's face you'll be able to slap them. The fast and more centered the movement the better the slap. You may repeat this until the time bar runs out and the attack box vanishes. The time bar will now be set for the opponent's attack and an evasion box will appear in the left corner. By dragging your cursor from this box across the screen you'll be able to dodge slaps. If you successfully dodge a counter attack box will briefly appear in the right corner allowing you a quick slap; likewise, if you fail to hit your foe's face in an attack they may have the opportunity to counter.

The battle ends when someone's health, represented by a number of flowers, runs out. You start the game with four roses but may collect more by beating aristocrats without being harmed. Lost hearts will also carry over.

There are five levels, each with progressing difficulty.

451327.overview:
In Red Remover the player is tasked with removing all red shapes from the field. While doing this, the player must be careful that none of the green shapes are removed from the field. There are a couple different color shapes and variables that the player must contend with to get this task done however.

The light red shapes, when selected, will disappear. The dark red shapes will not disappear when selected. They have to be removed from the screen by falling off the edges. All green shapes have to remain on the screen to successfully complete a level. The blue shapes are deemed neutral and can be selected to disappear or they can remain till the level is completed. The shapes in the game follow the laws of physics, so shapes will roll down ramps, change direction when banging into each other, and also fall when not properly supported. The game also introduces the player to a gravity variable. Gravity makes the effected shape fly in the direction that they are facing. Some levels also require timing, to ensure the green shapes stay on the screen.

The game features 45 levels plus a level editor, where player can create their own levels.

451328.overview: When you start playing you can choose between a runner or skater that needs to cross an obstacle course. Like the first game in the series, the game has two modes. In the adventure mode the goal is to reach the end of a map by avoiding or jumping over gaps in the floor. If you can’t ovoid or jump over a gap you can try to find a way around it by using the walls. The wall will then become the floor and the floor and ceiling will become the walls. In the infinite mode you run until you fall through a gap and by collecting boxes you can unlock additional characters. Witch can be bought in the shop. There is also a list of achievements that can be attempted to complete.The game is a sequel to Run 2.

451329.overview:
A short (10-second) collection of mini-games derived from the New Testament, this game puts the player in charge of a retro-styled Jesus Christ, harnessing player reflexes and platform-game problem-solving (run, jump) to re-enact Scriptural verses Luke 4:1-13, John 6:1-14, Mark 6:45-52, Matt 5:1-2, Mark 8:22-26, John 11:1-44 and Matt 8:1-4.

The left and right keyboard arrows are used to move, while the space bar is brought into play to work miracles (or "do Jesus things" as it says in the introduction, where it also notes that the goal of the 10-second gameplay session is "to save the humanity.")

Following the brief series of chunky-pixel screens, the player's overall success is measured by how many Apostles were swayed by the player's acrobatic feats.

451330.overview:
Reincarnation: A Demon's Day Out (sometimes abbreviated as ADDO) is a point and click adventure game from October 29, 2008. Written, animated, directed, programmed and produced by Christopher "Chris" Gianelloni, it is the first installment in The Reincarnation Series. The game is followed up by Reincarnation: Riley's Out Again. The plot centers around a demon who is sent to the human realm in order to bring back reincarnies to Hell.

Luke, a.k.a. The Devil, orders one of his demons to check out the latest reincarny who has escaped from Hell through a reincarny portal to the Earth Realm where he will be able to redeem his sins. Lucifer cannot just let the reincarnies leave seeing how there's a sort of reincarnation system set in place that says if too many souls escape through the portals and convert to the good side God will shut down the Hell operation altogether.

451332.overview: The Right Mix is a promotional browser game made for web design company Liquid Light and development company Land Securities from the United Kingdom. The game is about creating your own cocktails without causing a disaster. There is around 22 kinds of create-your-own-alcohol-drinks and you are awarded points for each successful recipe. The more complex the more points earned. The game end when your barman faints.

451334.overview:
When three-year old Simon discovers a stash of gold buried in the beach near his house, all kinds of crooks from around the world arrive by sea to get a piece! As Simon and his brother, you must defend your treasure from atop your inflatable raft by shooting balls at the enemy vessels until all the bad guys have been defeated. But these bad guys shoot back - if all the defenders go down, it's game over.

While at first Simon's raft is only big enough to fit him and his brother, upgrades can allow Simon's dog and Simon's friend to join the fight too. Raft upgrades and special ammunition like rockets and grenades can be bought between rounds with credits that are earned for completing waves and defeating enemies in the shortest time and with the least shots possible.

All units have a health bar that depletes when that unit is hit, but depending on the angle and velocity applied, units can knock enemy units clean off their rafts in a single shot or throw. It is also possible to ricochet projectiles off surfaces to hit units from behind and cause them to bump each other off their own rafts for maximum credits.

451335.overview:
Rebuild is a turn-based Flash game playable on browsers that was created by Sarah Northway. It was first released in January 2011 on twotowersgames.com.

It became popular the following month on Kongregate, where it had been played more than 2 million times until Mid-April and stood with its average score at the top 3 games overall.

The creator described it as a Sim City during a Zombie apocalypse. A Desktop-version of Rebuild 1 had been released in 2015.

451340.overview:
Ragdoll Achievement is an engaging and entertaining online game that offers players a unique and somewhat unconventional gaming experience. In this game, your mission is to subject a hapless ragdoll character to a series of increasingly absurd and comical experiments and challenges. Your goal? To inflict as much damage and chaos upon the ragdoll as creatively as possible.

With a variety of tools, weapons, and traps at your disposal, you'll embark on a journey to test the limits of ragdoll physics. Launch the ragdoll into hazardous environments, set off explosive devices, and watch as the physics engine takes over, sending your ragdoll character soaring, tumbling, and bouncing in hilarious and unpredictable ways.

The game's humorous and lighthearted approach to mayhem provides a delightful contrast to more serious and competitive games. As you progress, you'll earn points to unlock new tools and devices, enabling even more creative and over-the-top experiments.

Ragdoll Achievement is not only about destruction but also about exploration and discovery. Players are encouraged to experiment with different combinations of tools and traps to uncover unique and unexpected outcomes. With its charmingly chaotic gameplay and amusing ragdoll reactions, this game promises hours of laughter and entertainment.

So, if you're in the mood for some delightful and unconventional gaming fun, give Ragdoll Achievement a try. Challenge your creativity, enjoy the hilariously unexpected results, and see just how much chaos you can unleash upon your hapless ragdoll test subject. Have fun with Ragdoll Achievement, online and for free on Silvergames.com!

451341.overview:
Grow your kingdom, build alliances, and explore one of the deepest idle RPG's ever!

Use your money and influence to grow your kingdom from a single farm to a huge realm that earns wealth even while you're not online! In Realm Grinder, the player is given an incredible array of choices in how they build forge their new kingdom.

451342.overview: Descend into the Dungeon of Chaos, retrieve the Amulet of Yendor, kill all who stand in your way and return with your prize.

451343.overview:
Relic Of War is a strategy game developed by Toge Productions and published on Kongregate on August 16, 2012.

The year is 1947 and The Great War never ended. A powerful ancient relic has been uncovered! Now, twisted experiments and giant war machines walk the battlefield…forever changing the face of war! Relic of War is a strategy game set in an alternate 1940’s timeline. Train your soldiers, unlock new technology, and command your troops to victory!

451344.overview: In this game, the player raises their character from the foetal stage as a man, woman, or a two-torsoed gender hybrid. With Egoraptor as the host, there are 29 different endings.

451345.overview:
Renegade Racing is an adrenaline-filled, wacky multiplayer racing game. Perform epic stunts to gain turbo and race your way to victory!

Gravity-bending worlds, crazy unlockable cars, awesome power-ups and a whole lot of action awaits.

Compete in 1v5 multiplayer races and climb your way up the arena tiers. Each new tier you unlock will give you access to new levels: from the peaceful Docks, to the trap-filled caves of the Ice Caverns, to the fiery Devil's Island and to more new worlds coming soon!

Unlock and upgrade over 10 crazy cars, including a sleek police car, a Not Doppler bus, a tank, and a monster truck hearse (don't ask...)

Want to show off? Complete missions and upgrade your vehicle to unlock 16 different power-ups and a range of vehicle skins.

Don't forget, this isn’t just a game about driving. Performing stunts is key to your success! Every stunt you perform improves your turbo, allowing you to speed past other players to victory!

Ready for some crazy multiplayer racing action? Download Renegade Racing now!

451346.overview:
Republia's rival nation Antegria has been defeated at war and rebel elements have been quashed! Now the centralised government needs to win over the hearts and minds of its citizens -- with the player on the front lines, comrade, as the editor of the national newspaper! Sitting at a news desk (bearing an uncanny ressemblance to an '80s Macintosh desktop publishing setup), players oversee stories coming in over the news wire services and get to select which stories to run and how much space to allocate them on the front page before the work day ends and the papers go to the presses. Some sensational stories (about, eg., celebrities, weather and sports) increase readership interest, while other stories -- about policy triumphs and the like -- increase loyalty to the government. Bad news, however, lowers government loyalty.

Over the first few days of your stewardship of the paper, the player's bosses in the government will assign loyalty goals and readership quotas that need to be met at risk of the comfort and safety of the player's family, under government supervision. Later, a garbled news channel suggests that the pendulum may be swinging back the other way and it might be in the player's best interests to run stories critical of the old bosses in preparation for the arrival of the new bosses.

451347.overview: Kill all your enemies with your gun by making a perfect angle and by taking a right shot.

451349.overview:
Robokill 2: Leviathan Five is a sequel to Robokill: Titan Prime and the player controls a robot in a space station. The game has three episodes and twelve missions in total. The basic gameplay is similar to the first game. The robot needs to make its way through connected rooms and try to clear all of them as they are invaded by robots and creatures. The keyboard is used for moving and the mouse for aiming.

There are crates on every room and they contain traps, money and recharge for shields. When an enemy is killed or a chest is discovered, money is provided to use in a shop to upgrade the character with four different types of guns or different battle items. Certain guns require a minimum experience level in order to use them. Looted items can be sold in the shop as well. Some rooms and shops have teleportation and some rooms require a key for passing. The robot can be customized in an inventory screen with different types of weapons and items, selected from a larger pool. When dead, the player can continue, but some rooms will be recovered by the enemy and some cash is lost. There are many types of enemies and the often apply more advanced strategies such as trying to ambush the robot.

451350.overview:
Robot Wants Kitty is a short metroidvania style platforming game. The player controls a robot moving around in a single huge map, shooting enemies, collecting power-ups and the end goal is to reach the kitty. The game features 8-bit style pixel graphics and sound effects.

The robot starts out without any abilities other than being able to move left and right. Collect the power-ups scattered around the map to gain abilities like jumping, shooting, flying etc. The level is designed in such a way that collecting each power-up will give the player access to new parts of the map. For example you first collect a jump ability, by jumping you can reach the laser power-up. The laser allows the robot to kill an enemy that is blocking a tunnel. The tunnel leads to another part of the map where there is a double-jump power-up, and so forth.

There are red walking enemies, blue floating enemies and shooting turrets throughout the map. In one part of the map there is an end-boss type enemy which consists of many blue eyeballs which is guarding a powerful upgrade. There are motes of toxic waste, fall into it and you die. Dying will respawn the robot at the last check point. The player has infinite lives but each time you die it adds 20 seconds of the overall time. Shooting enemies takes awards the player by taking one second away from the timer. Reaching the end goal in the fastest time is a subgoal of the game.

Other elements include computers which act as check points. There are red, green and blue keys and gates, collect the keys to open the gates. Red blocks can be destroyed using the missile power-up later in the game.

451351.overview:
Rokko Chan (ロッコちゃん) is a 2D side-scrolling platformer made in Flash. While it is technically not a Mega Man fangame, as it lacks any official characters from the series, it is largely considered by many to be one, as its art style and many of its core gameplay elements are borrowed from the series. Players take control of the titular Rokko Chan, a robot with a human's memories, and battle against six Robot Masters released by the nefarious Dr. Mad in his quest for military domination of the world.

As aforementioned, the game takes its core jumping-and-shooting elements straight from earlier Mega Man games; however, there is one key difference that takes inspiration from the Mega Man X series: Rokko Chan has the ability to perform a high-speed dash, which she can then jump out of to carry her momentum even further forward. The trade-off of this is that when she does not jump out of a dash, she can jump significantly higher, making both of them viable movement options. As always, players may challenge the game's six Robot Masters (Hockey Man, Volcano Man, Lightning Man, Jet Man, Rolling Man, and Forest Man) in any order they choose and claim their weapons by defeating them before battling Dr. Mad himself in his fortress.

451353.overview:
The Room Tribute is a fan made game on Newgrounds based off the movie The Room. The game takes place just a few minutes or so before the movie starts. Johnny just got done working at the bank when suddenly, an earthquake commences, causing chaos and destruction throughout San Fransisco. Johnny, however, is unharmed and goes on with his life just like in the movie. You will be able to go through the entire story of The Room. The script, sans a few added lines and a few things not ever in the movie, is very accurately re-made in this "tribute".

The gameplay is in a point-and-click style with minor RPG and quick time events styles as well. Also, there are 10 spoons that you can collect within the game.

451534.overview:
RPG Shooter: Starwish is a Web Game that is Exactly What It Says on the Tin — a Horizontal Scrolling Shooter with RPG Elements. It was made in Adobe Flash and released in 2011.

Specifically, the author describes it as "a unique blend of a shooter, RPG, visual novel and dating sim". A lot of the drive of the game is based upon the storyline, the character interaction, and the upgrades and level ups for the main "shooter" game, which is played during missions on various sites of interest on the current planet.

451749.overview: The life of a RescueBlade pilot is never dull. Take flight in a moment's notice to save stranded sailors or put out blazing fires. Grab your gear. Duty calls!

451774.overview:
Redline Rumble is an Adobe Shockwave player-based racing game developed by Richard Smith and serviced by shockwave.com. Zip It appears to be a follow-up to a game series called Zaps.

Redline Rumble (2003) is a monumental first work that broke the beginning of the series, and the way it proceeds is a pink slip through a 1 vs 1 road race.

In fact, this game was originally a web game from ZipZaps, an RC car manufacturer, that came out to promote the 2002 movie Fast and Furious 2 . What was replaced after the release of the movie was the birth of Redline Rumble.

461980.overview: Ratchet & Clank: Going Mobile is a platform shooter mobile game developed by Handheld Games and published by Sony Pictures Mobile. It is a spin-off of Sony Computer Entertainment's Ratchet & Clank series.
